description.describe_ch: Python具有明確、簡潔、優雅、易讀的語法，讓程式新手有較低的學習門檻，已經成為許多人學習程式的第一選擇。而其在人工智慧、資料科學、網路程式、自然語言等各方面強大的開發能力，也讓許多程式設計老手，從使用其他程式語言轉而成為Python愛好者。學習容易卻功能強大正是Python的魅力所在。本課程不像基礎的C/C＋＋或Java，要求學生要有很強的程式邏輯與電腦系統觀念，而是要訓練學生如何將想要完成的功能，使用Python語言輕鬆的建構出來，讓學生在學會Python之後可以很容易的應用到各式各樣的應用領域，成為加值未來職涯發展的強大的工具。
description.describe_eh: Python has clear, concise, elegant, and easy-to-read syntax, which makes it easy for novice programmers to learn. It has become the first choice for many beginners to learn programming. And its powerful development ability in artificial intelligence, data science, network programs, natural languages and other aspects has also made many programming veterans turn from using other programming languages to Python lovers. The charm of Python lies in its easy learning and powerful functions. Unlike basic C/C++ or Java, this course requires students to have strong programming logic and computer system concepts. Instead, it trains students how to easily construct the functions they want to complete using the Python language, so that students can easily apply Python to a variety of application fields after learning it, becoming a powerful tool for adding value to future career development.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
Course Introduction: Python Introduction and Execution Environment Installation

Introduction to the course structure and expectations. Set up Python and run the first script using Anaconda.
 
https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/appetite.html
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en: Install Python and set up the coding environment.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
Data Types, Variables, and Operators
 
Study basic data types, variable assignment, and operators. Explore how Python handles different value types.
 
https://www.w3schools.com/python/python_datatypes.asp
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en: Complete coding exercises on variables and operators. Join live Q&A session.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
Data Storage Containers: Tuples, Lists, Dictionaries, and Sets
 
Learn about Python's core data containers and their usage. Practice storing and accessing structured data.
 
https://www.w3schools.com/python/python_lists.asp
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en: Practice data container usage. Discuss data organization in groups.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
Selection Structures
 
Explore conditional logic using if-else structures. Apply conditions to guide program flow.
 
https://www.w3schools.com/python/python_conditions.asp
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en: Solve logic problems with conditions. Instructor explains use cases live.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
Loops
 
Practice writing for and while loops. Understand iteration and repetition in code.
 
https://www.w3schools.com/python/python_for_loops.asp
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en: Complete loop-based coding challenges. In-class walkthrough of patterns.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
Functions and Recursion
 
Define and call functions. Learn recursive structures and when to use them effectively.
 
https://www.w3schools.com/python/python_functions.asp
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en: Write recursive functions. Discuss advantages and limitations.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
Comprehensions, Random Number Generation, and File Reading
 
Use list/dictionary comprehensions. Generate random data and read from text files.
 
https://www.w3schools.com/python/python_lists_comprehension.asp
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en: Work on comprehension tasks. Read files and manipulate content.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
Modules, Packages, and Standalone Scripts
 
Understand how to organize code with modules and packages. Write a standalone Python script.
 
https://www.w3schools.com/python/python_modules.asp
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en: Build your own module. Try importing code from different files.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
Midterm Programming  
 
Complete the assigned midterm programming task.

Classes and Exceptions 1
 
Define custom classes and handle exceptions. Learn basic object-oriented programming.
 
https://www.w3schools.com/python/python_classes.asp
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en: Code simple classes. Catch errors using try-except.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
Classes and Exceptions 2
 
Continue class design with attributes and methods. Handle more advanced exception logic.
 
https://www.w3schools.com/python/python_try_except.asp
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en: Extend classes. Use custom exceptions. Peer discussion.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
Advanced String Processing
 
Process and manipulate strings using advanced methods and regular expressions.
 
https://www.w3schools.com/python/python_strings_methods.asp
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en: Write string parsing functions. Explore regular expressions.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
Working with Folders and Files
 
Work with file paths, read/write files, and organize content by folder structure.
 
https://www.w3schools.com/python/python_file_handling.asp
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en: Navigate folders. Read and write text and CSV files.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
Using Python Libraries
 
Explore commonly used Python libraries and their purposes.
 
https://www.w3schools.com/python/python_json.asp
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en: Try numpy, pandas, or matplotlib. Analyze use cases.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
Third Party Modules
 
Install and use third-party packages with pip. Try libraries beyond the standard library.
 
https://www.w3schools.com/python/python_pip.asp
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en: Install and experiment with new libraries. Share findings.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
Web Crawler
 
Write simple web crawlers using requests and BeautifulSoup.
 
https://www.w3schools.com/python/python_web_scraping.asp
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en: Write a crawler script. Extract data from real websites.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
Final Project
 
Prepare and deliver final group presentations.

The Future of AI and Python
 
https://www.tensorflow.org/
https://openai.com/research
 
Students will study an assigned AI–Python article or video to understand emerging opportunities, technologies, and future directions.
weeklyScds.tpd_ass_en: Students will submit a brief reflection on AI’s future impact and mention one Python tool they think will matter in the future.

gradeRules.evalb_memo_en: Attendance will affect the final grade. Points may be deducted for being late or absent without notice.
Weekly or unit-based assignments designed to reinforce understanding. Late submissions may receive point deductions.
Includes online and in-class discussions, group activities, and overall engagement. Active participation is strongly encouraged, especially in this EMI (English as a Medium of Instruction) course.
Rather than a traditional written or in-class exam, the midterm will be a programming assignment designed by the instructor to reflect the core skills taught in this course.

Students will work in groups to complete a self-chosen project and present it at the end of the semester, demonstrating creativity, teamwork, and practical application of Python skills. As this is an EMI course, the final presentation must be delivered entirely in English.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
出席狀況：鐘響後立即點名，逾時者以遲到論。曠課三次即達扣考標準。
作業：所有作業必須在規定期限前繳交完成且不抄襲，不接受補交。
課堂討論參與：授課過程中不定期點名回答問題。
第一次小考：上機考試，考試過程中違反考試規定者，以零分計算，並以逢甲大學學生獎懲辦法相關規定處理。
第二次小考：上機考試，考試過程中違反考試規定者，以零分計算，並以逢甲大學學生獎懲辦法相關規定處理。
第三次小考：上機考試，考試過程中違反考試規定者，以零分計算，並以逢甲大學學生獎懲辦法相關規定處理。
gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en:
1. Copying homework and programs, as well as cheating in exams, are strictly prohibited.
  2. Homework and programs cannot be copied from other students' homework programs or the internet. Violators will receive 0 points for this
    homework or program. If there are three instances of plagiarism, the homework grade for this semester will be calculated as 0 points.
  3. The exam cannot refer to unauthorized data or other people's answers. Violators will be considered as cheating, and the exam will be counted as 0
    points. Those with serious circumstances will be punished according to school regulations.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1. 學生應按照課程時間表，準時到達教室。遲到可能會影響到其他同學和教授的學習體驗。
2. 學生應尊重教授、助教以及其他同學的意見和觀點。適當的言語和行為可以營造良好的學習環境。
3. 在課堂期間，學生應該關閉或靜音手機以及其他電子設備，以免干擾自己和其他人的學習。
4. 學生必須遵守學術誠信，不得抄襲他人的作業或筆記，也不能在考試中作弊。違反學術誠信可能會導致嚴重後果。
5. 學生應該積極參與課堂討論，提問和分享自己的觀點。這不僅有助於自己的學習，也可以豐富整個課堂的學習氛圍。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Please watch the course videos before the specified time. Do not ignore them or confuse the number of times you have watched them. 
Please arrive on time for class and do not be late or leave early. 
During class, you are prohibited from using your mobile phone for purposes other than classroom learning, such as chatting on communication software, watching videos, playing games, etc. 
During class, stay quiet and listen attentively. Do not talk or chat with each other to affect the order of the class. 
Please pay attention to the cleanliness of the classroom environment. Please do not leave personal belongings behind when leaving the classroom after class.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en: This course is taught entirely in English. Please watch the course video several times to become familiar with learning in English.
